VariableID:d041fd191f28d456f7a10a525fec0.name: color/on-surface/3 (Blue 15)
VariableID:d041fd191f28d456f7a10a525fec0.description: Darkest text and icon fill used for titles for pages or components

VariableID:06c01b17c4b3623fe2fb2bd6c3bb9.name: color/on-surface/inverse-2 (Electric Blue 80)
VariableID:06c01b17c4b3623fe2fb2bd6c3bb9.description: Darker text and icon fill on dark backgrounds

VariableID:78ad1d161a596986f604c0b6cb02a.name: color/container/1 (Neutral 100)
VariableID:78ad1d161a596986f604c0b6cb02a.description: Default container background fill for components such as cards and modals

VariableID:e6c1cc5b188acb1f17e5f9fec5282.name: Neutral/Foreground/1/Rest
VariableID:e6c1cc5b188acb1f17e5f9fec5282.description: Primary text rest state (i.e. first line of chat list item, unread channels, main body copy, text color of messages sent). Passes 4.5:1 contrast over Backgrounds 1-6

VariableID:3990fe78508c824b40a62a078055d.name: Neutral/Foreground/2/Rest
VariableID:3990fe78508c824b40a62a078055d.description: Secondary text rest state (i.e. message preview of chat list item, read channels, primary icon color). Passes 4.5:1 contrast over Backgrounds 1-6

VariableID:b2855cb7f36518cd917c6a794ab9f.name: Neutral/Foreground/3/Rest
VariableID:b2855cb7f36518cd917c6a794ab9f.description: Tertiary text rest state (i.e. names/time stamp on message bubbles, preview on activity list items, secondary icon color). Passes 4.5:1 contrast over Backgrounds 1-6

VariableID:4fd5764e12c2bd2d14f4f04d917e1.name: Neutral/Foreground/4/Rest
VariableID:4fd5764e12c2bd2d14f4f04d917e1.description: This was added to make placeholder text in input fields subtler when compared against user inputted text. Use this sparingly as the text only passes 4.5:1 contrast up until Background 3

VariableID:40fc59b684b0dc7409f6aa62ef84c.name: Neutral/Foreground/Disabled/Rest
VariableID:40fc59b684b0dc7409f6aa62ef84c.description: Disabled/Inactive state for controls that the user can’t interact with. Note: In V9 we simplified the number of disabled tokens supported, make sure associated background is updated as well.

VariableID:cf8e4de71eefdd62d61c62aefb4ad.name: Neutral/Foreground/Inverted/1/Rest
VariableID:cf8e4de71eefdd62d61c62aefb4ad.description: Used for text/icon elements on inverted background surfaces. True inversion across all themes

VariableID:4b451713f192c40ba0539ac028db0.name: Neutral/Foreground/Static/Inverted/Rest
VariableID:4b451713f192c40ba0539ac028db0.description: Inverted text that needs to stay white across all themes. Examples of this include confirmation/toasts where the background is dark in an other light UI (but then in dark theme we want to keep the toast bg dark)

VariableID:ae87039beed99b8b525f288e9c3dd.name: Brand/Foreground/1/Rest
VariableID:ae87039beed99b8b525f288e9c3dd.description: This is good for text elements that need to use the brand color and are not links. Used in Unread Dividers for the text and Fluent v9 tinted badge, this set contains the Teams primary brand color for light and dark theme

VariableID:9103164719e0a2a9a8fe67a0b8efe.name: Brand/Foreground/Link/Rest
VariableID:9103164719e0a2a9a8fe67a0b8efe.description: Text links that need to be brand colored

VariableID:306814606bb332d6e689638f726ba.name: Neutral/Stroke/3/Rest
VariableID:306814606bb332d6e689638f726ba.description: In a UI with a lot of linework and there’s a need to establish more hierarchy between sections, can leverage this one as the secondary divider in combination w/ Neutral Stroke 2 over Backgrounds 1-2

VariableID:90b4b2452a0af8007dbe1834d3331.name: Neutral/Stroke/Focus/1/Rest
VariableID:90b4b2452a0af8007dbe1834d3331.description: Added to support keyboard focus borders. This should only show up when the user invokes the control via keyboarding
